primary_anchor_zh: 竖琴位于宽大舞台幕布左侧
story_reason_zh: 竖琴被移去调弦，随后放回幕布左侧

shot_design.role_zh: 建立主体与主要视觉锚点
shot_design.outline_zh: 大型竖琴在空剧院舞台的宽幕布旁，琴弦接收稳定的侧光。
shot_design.anchor_visibility_zh: 竖琴位于宽大舞台幕布左侧占据足够画面面积并清楚可见。

shot_design.outline_zh: 舞台工作人员缓慢将竖琴推到宽幕布后并离开画面；随后呈现宽大舞台幕布及其左侧空位。
shot_design.main_action_zh: 舞台工作人员缓慢将竖琴推到宽幕布后并离开画面
shot_design.connection_to_story_zh: 离场动作与原有故事原因对应，动作缓慢、短距离，镜头保持固定。
shot_design.remaining_visual_zh: 宽大舞台幕布及其左侧空位

shot_design.role_zh: 重新呈现主体并触发长期召回
shot_design.outline_zh: 舞台工作人员缓慢将竖琴推回画面并停在宽幕布左侧
shot_design.main_action_zh: 舞台工作人员缓慢将竖琴推回画面并停在宽幕布左侧
shot_design.visual_correspondence_zh: Shot 3 恢复竖琴位于宽大舞台幕布左侧，参照物保持清楚可见。

generation_prompts.caption: A fixed wide shot frames a large concert harp to the left of a broad theater curtain on an empty stage. Soft side light rests across the strings.

A fixed wide shot shows a large concert harp to the left of a broad theater curtain on an empty stage. A stagehand slowly rolls the harp behind the broad theater curtain and out of frame. The fixed camera then holds on the broad theater curtain and the empty stage area to its left. The lower edge of the curtain moves gently.

A fixed wide shot holds on the broad theater curtain and the empty stage area to its left. A stagehand slowly rolls a large concert harp back into frame and stops it to the left of the broad theater curtain.

transition_design.shot_2_exit_action_zh: 舞台工作人员缓慢将竖琴推到宽幕布后并离开画面
transition_design.shot_2_remaining_visual_zh: 宽大舞台幕布及其左侧空位
transition_design.shot_3_return_action_zh: 舞台工作人员缓慢将竖琴推回画面并停在宽幕布左侧
transition_design.design_note_zh: Shot 2 在固定镜头内先展示自然离场，再保留背景；Shot 3 用对应动作让主体回到画面。

duration_design.rationale_zh: Shot 1 保持 24 blocks 建立主体与视觉锚点；Shot 2 调整为 12 blocks，使主体缺席区间介于 V2 的 16 blocks 与 V3 的 8 blocks 之间；Shot 3 调整为 12 blocks，在总长 48 blocks 下形成中等记忆间隔难度。
